questions.explanation: 句意：Walker很快“求助于”中医急救方法，因为心肺复苏术（CPR）可能不够有效。turn to 意为“转向，求助于”，符合语境。look for（寻找），put forward（提出），stick to（坚持）均不符合题意。
questions.supplement:
A(looked for)：语境句：She looked for her lost keys everywhere but failed to find them. 固定搭配：look for help, look for opportunities
B(put forward)：语境句：Several practical suggestions were put forward at the meeting. 固定搭配：put forward a proposal, put forward an idea
C(turned to)：语境句：When he was in trouble, he always turned to his parents for advice. 固定搭配：turn to sb for help, turn to pages
D(stick to)：语境句：No matter what happens, you must stick to your original plan. 固定搭配：stick to a plan, stick to the rules

questions.explanation: 根据上下文，此时使用心肺复苏术（CPR）可能不如中医方法“有效（effective）”，并且有导致骨折的风险。convenient（方便的），powerful（强大的），essential（必要的）均不符合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(convenient)：语境句：It is convenient for us to take the subway to work every day. 固定搭配：be convenient for sb, highly convenient
B(effective)：语境句：Taking notes is an effective way to improve your memory. 固定搭配：highly effective, cost-effective
C(powerful)：语境句：The speech was so powerful that it moved the entire audience to tears. 固定搭配：powerful weapon, powerful tool
D(essential)：语境句：Water and sunlight are essential for the growth of plants. 固定搭配：be essential to/for, absolutely essential

questions.explanation: 句意：在硬地上做CPR有导致女孩骨折的“风险（risk）”。a risk of doing sth 为固定用法。force（力量），disaster（灾难），function（功能）不合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(risk)：语境句：There is a high risk of getting injured if you don't warm up before exercising. 固定搭配：at risk, take a risk
B(force)：语境句：The door was stuck, so he had to use force to open it. 固定搭配：by force, driving force
C(disaster)：语境句：The earthquake was a terrible disaster that destroyed many homes. 固定搭配：natural disaster, avoid disaster
D(function)：语境句：The main function of this software is to protect your computer from viruses. 固定搭配：serve a function, body function

questions.explanation: 句意：Walker给老师打电话，在老师的“远程（remote）”指导下进行急救。因为是通过电话沟通，所以是remote guidance。realistic（现实的），recent（最近的），regular（定期的）不符合上下文语境。
questions.supplement:
A(realistic)：语境句：We need to set realistic goals rather than aim too high. 固定搭配：realistic goal, highly realistic
B(recent)：语境句：Recent studies have shown a link between stress and poor health. 固定搭配：in recent years, recent events
C(regular)：语境句：Regular exercise is beneficial to both physical and mental health. 固定搭配：regular exercise, on a regular basis
D(remote)：语境句：During the pandemic, remote learning became the primary way of education. 固定搭配：remote control, remote area

questions.explanation: 下文第49空前明确提到“Spraying cold water on the face...”，此处为原词复现，指喷“冷”水来刺激皮肤。选C。
questions.supplement:
A(warm)：语境句：A warm smile can make a stranger feel welcome. 固定搭配：warm welcome, keep warm
B(clean)：语境句：Access to clean drinking water is essential for public health. 固定搭配：clean up, keep clean
C(cold)：语境句：She caught a severe cold after walking in the freezing rain. 固定搭配：catch a cold, freezing cold
D(fresh)：语境句：We need some fresh air to clear our minds after working for hours. 固定搭配：fresh air, fresh fruit

questions.explanation: 下文紧接着提到“After over 20 pats（拍打）”和“tapping the elbow area”，此处意为“拍打”她的手肘区域，pat作动词，符合语境。squeeze（挤压），wrap（包裹），grab（抓）不符。
questions.supplement:
A(squeezed)：语境句：He squeezed the orange to get some fresh juice for breakfast. 固定搭配：squeeze in, squeeze out
B(wrapped)：语境句：The mother wrapped the baby in a blanket to keep him warm. 固定搭配：wrap up, be wrapped in
C(patted)：语境句：The teacher patted the student on the shoulder to encourage him. 固定搭配：pat sb on the back, a gentle pat
D(grabbed)：语境句：He grabbed his coat and rushed out of the door to catch the bus. 固定搭配：grab a bite, grab attention

questions.explanation: 女孩之前处于昏迷状态（unconscious），拍打之后她开始“醒来（wake up）”并且能说几句话了。cheer up（振作起来），give up（放弃），dress up（盛装打扮）均不符合。
questions.supplement:
A(cheer up)：语境句：We threw a surprise party to cheer her up after she failed the exam. 固定搭配：cheer sb up, cheer for
B(wake up)：语境句：It took a cup of strong coffee to wake him up completely. 固定搭配：wake up to reality, early wake-up
C(give up)：语境句：No matter how difficult the task is, you should never give up easily. 固定搭配：give up smoking, give up hope
D(dress up)：语境句：The children love to dress up in funny costumes for Halloween. 固定搭配：dress up as, dress appropriately

questions.explanation: 句意：中医“认为（holds）”拍打手肘区域可以帮助疏通经络。hold 在此引申为“持有（观点），认为”。deny（否认），doubt（怀疑），require（要求）均不合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(denies)：语境句：The suspect strongly denies having anything to do with the crime. 固定搭配：deny doing sth, deny a request
B(doubts)：语境句：Nobody doubts his ability to complete the project on time. 固定搭配：without doubt, cast doubt on
C(requires)：语境句：Mastering a foreign language requires a lot of time and practice. 固定搭配：require sb to do sth, meet requirements
D(holds)：语境句：The scientists hold the view that climate change is a pressing issue. 固定搭配：hold a belief, hold a meeting

questions.explanation: 后文Walker提到“It's the wisdom of the ancients（这是古人的智慧）”，因此向脸上喷冷水也是一种“古老的（ancient）”方法。awful（糟糕的），alternative（替代的），amusing（有趣的）不符语境。
questions.supplement:
A(ancient)：语境句：Tourists are fascinated by the ancient architecture in the historical city. 固定搭配：ancient history, ancient times
B(awful)：语境句：The weather was so awful that we had to cancel our picnic. 固定搭配：feel awful, awful weather
C(alternative)：语境句：Solar power provides a cleaner alternative to fossil fuels. 固定搭配：alternative energy, alternative method
D(amusing)：语境句：He told an amusing story that made everyone burst into laughter. 固定搭配：find sth amusing, highly amusing

questions.explanation: 面对网上的名声和赞扬，Walker说功劳不在他，而是古人的智慧，这说明他是“谦虚地（humbly）”表态。proudly（自豪地），humorously（幽默地），originally（最初地）不符合人物当时的心境。
questions.supplement:
A(proudly)：语境句：She proudly displayed the gold medal she won in the competition. 固定搭配：smile proudly, proudly announce
B(humbly)：语境句：He humbly accepted the award, thanking everyone who supported him. 固定搭配：humbly apologize, humbly request
C(humorously)：语境句：The teacher humorously pointed out the mistake, making the class laugh. 固定搭配：speak humorously, humorously describe
D(originally)：语境句：The building was originally designed as a library but is now a museum. 固定搭配：originally planned, originally from

questions.explanation: Walker认为自己没什么了不起，只是“应用（apply）”了老师教给他的方法来救人。remember（记住），understand（理解），acquire（获得）不如apply契合“将学到的知识用于实践”的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(remember)：语境句：Please remember to turn off the lights before you leave the room. 固定搭配：remember doing sth, remember to do sth
B(apply)：语境句：It is important to apply theoretical knowledge to practical situations. 固定搭配：apply for a job, apply to
C(understand)：语境句：I fully understand your concerns regarding the safety of the project. 固定搭配：understand clearly, hard to understand
D(acquire)：语境句：Reading extensively helps students acquire a larger vocabulary. 固定搭配：acquire knowledge, acquire skills

questions.explanation: 句意：他认为做一名医生“意味着（means）”通过实践不断获得并检验经验。mean doing sth 意为“意味着做某事”。deserve（值得），avoid（避免），decline（下降，拒绝）不符合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(means)：语境句：Accepting this challenging job means spending less time with my family. 固定搭配：mean doing sth, mean to do sth
B(deserves)：语境句：After months of hard work, she certainly deserves a long vacation. 固定搭配：deserve attention, deserve to be
C(avoids)：语境句：He usually takes the subway to work to avoid getting stuck in traffic. 固定搭配：avoid doing sth, avoid contact
D(declines)：语境句：The demand for traditional cameras declines as smartphones become more popular. 固定搭配：decline an invitation, a sharp decline

questions.explanation: 要到中医药大学学习，需要具备较高的中文水平，因此他经历了一年“密集/强化（intensive）”的中文学习。casual（随意的），effortless（不费力的），informal（非正式的）不能体现学习的深度和难度。
questions.supplement:
A(casual)：语境句：We had a casual conversation over coffee about our holiday plans. 固定搭配：casual clothes, casual talk
B(effortless)：语境句：The skilled dancer made the complex movements look completely effortless. 固定搭配：effortless grace, effortless success
C(intensive)：语境句：She took an intensive training course to prepare for the marathon. 固定搭配：intensive care, intensive study
D(informal)：语境句：The meeting was quite informal, with everyone sharing their ideas freely. 固定搭配：informal discussion, informal language

questions.explanation: 下文紧接着提到神农尝百草（who tasted most of the herbal medicine...），利用原词复现可知，Walker也是亲自去“品尝（tasted）”中草药。gather（收集），plant（种植），study（研究）虽说得通，但缺乏原词复现的巧妙对照。
questions.supplement:
A(tasted)：语境句：She tasted the soup carefully to see if it needed more salt. 固定搭配：taste like, taste sweet/bitter
B(gathered)：语境句：A large crowd gathered in the square to celebrate the festival. 固定搭配：gather information, gather together
C(planted)：语境句：The volunteers planted thousands of trees to protect the local environment. 固定搭配：plant seeds, plant trees
D(studied)：语境句：He studied the map for a few minutes before deciding on the route. 固定搭配：study abroad, study hard

questions.explanation: 句意：为了了解草药的性质和治疗“效果/功效（effects）”。healing effects 是固定搭配，意为“疗效”。outcome（结果），measure（措施），period（时期）不符合此处中医术语的表达习惯。
questions.supplement:
A(outcomes)：语境句：The long-term outcomes of this educational reform are yet to be seen. 固定搭配：positive outcome, learning outcome
B(measures)：语境句：The government has taken effective measures to control the spread of the disease. 固定搭配：take measures, safety measures
C(periods)：语境句：The country experienced long periods of peace and economic growth. 固定搭配：time period, transition period
D(effects)：语境句：Scientists are studying the long-term effects of global warming on marine life. 固定搭配：healing effects, side effects, have an effect on

vocab_pack.definition_en: to spread rapidly widely through the internet or social media
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 在社交媒体上迅速传播、走红
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为过去时 went viral，主语为 Joel Mikael Walker，表示「走红」这一动作发生在过去。
vocab_pack.example_en: The video of the rescue went viral within hours.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那个救援视频在几小时内就火了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: A German young man ... went viral on social media

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 fell 为 fall 的过去式，与形容词 unconscious 构成系表结构，表示「陷入昏迷」这一过去动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: The hiker fell unconscious due to heatstroke.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那位徒步者因中暑昏倒了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a girl who fell unconscious while hiking

vocab_pack.definition_en: to start using or doing something as a method or help
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 转向（使用某方法）；求助于
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 turned to 为过去时，后接宾语 traditional Chinese emergency methods，表示「转而使用」某种方法。
vocab_pack.example_en: When the medicine failed, she turned to acupuncture.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当药物无效时，她转向了针灸。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Walker quickly turned to traditional Chinese emergency methods

vocab_pack.definition_en: the possibility that something bad may happen
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 there was a risk of breaking her bones，risk of 后接动名词，表示「有骨折的风险」。
vocab_pack.example_en: There is a high risk of infection after surgery.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 手术后感染风险很高。
vocab_pack.from_passage: there was a risk of breaking her bones on the hard ground

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 breaking 是动名词，作 of 的宾语；her bones 为复数泛指，但学习时用单数不定式 break a bone。
vocab_pack.example_en: He was careful not to break a bone during the fall.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他小心以免摔倒时骨折。
vocab_pack.from_passage: risk of breaking her bones

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 phoned 为过去时，及物动词，后接宾语 his teacher Song Zhaopu。
vocab_pack.example_en: She phoned the doctor immediately after the accident.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 事故发生后她立刻给医生打了电话。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Walker phoned his teacher Song Zhaopu

vocab_pack.definition_en: with the help or direction of someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 under his remote guidance 为介词短语作状语，表示「在他的远程指导下」；remote 为形容词修饰 guidance。
vocab_pack.example_en: Under the teacher's guidance, the students completed the experiment.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在老师的指导下，学生们完成了实验。
vocab_pack.from_passage: under his remote guidance

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: sprayed cold water on her face
vocab_pack.definition_en: to force liquid in small drops onto a surface
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 sprayed 为过去时，cold water 是 sprayed 的宾语，on her face 为地点状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The nurse sprayed cold water on the patient's forehead.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 护士把冷水喷在病人的前额上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: sprayed cold water on her face

vocab_pack.definition_en: to tap or strike lightly with the hand
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 patted 为过去时，及物动词，后接宾语 her elbow area。
vocab_pack.example_en: She patted the child on the back to comfort him.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她轻拍孩子的背来安慰他。
vocab_pack.from_passage: patted her elbow area

vocab_pack.definition_en: a light quick touch with the hand
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 pats 为可数名词复数，作介词 over 的宾语，表示「超过20下轻拍」。
vocab_pack.example_en: After a few pats, the baby stopped crying.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 拍了几下之后，婴儿停止了哭泣。
vocab_pack.from_passage: After over 20 pats

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 to wake up 为不定式，作 started 的宾语补足语；wake up 是短语动词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She woke up to find the sun shining.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她醒来发现阳光明媚。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the girl started to wake up

vocab_pack.definition_en: to say a short amount of speech
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 could speak a few words 中 speak 为情态动词后的原形；a few words 是动词宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: After the surgery, he could speak a few words.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 手术后他能说几句话了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: she could speak a few words

vocab_pack.definition_en: to believe or maintain an opinion
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 holds 为一般现在时第三人称单数，主语 Traditional Chinese medicine 为单数，hold that 后接宾语从句。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many experts hold that exercise is essential for health.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多专家认为锻炼对健康至关重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Traditional Chinese medicine holds that tapping the elbow area...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to strike lightly with a quick motion
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 tapping 为动名词，作 holds that 从句的主语，表示「拍打肘部区域」这一动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: He tapped the table to get her attention.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他轻敲桌子以引起她的注意。
vocab_pack.from_passage: tapping the elbow area

vocab_pack.definition_en: to remove blockages in the channels through which qi (vital energy) flows, in traditional Chinese medicine
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 clear 为及物动词原形（can help clear 中 help 后接省略 to 的不定式），energy paths 为宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Acupuncture is used to clear energy paths in the body.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 针灸用于疏通身体的经络。
vocab_pack.from_passage: can help clear energy paths

vocab_pack.definition_zh: 改善血液流动/促进血液循环
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 improve 位于 can help 后，为动词原形；the blood flow 为宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Regular exercise can improve blood flow to the brain.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 规律运动可以改善大脑的血液流动。
vocab_pack.from_passage: improve the blood flow

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to regain consciousness
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 使某人恢复意识/唤醒某人
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 to make someone conscious 为不定式短语，作 method 的定语；make 后接宾语 someone 和形容词 conscious 作宾补。
vocab_pack.example_en: The cold water made the fainted man conscious.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 冷水让那个昏倒的人苏醒过来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: an ancient method to make someone conscious

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause a response in the skin by touching or applying something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 stimulating 为动名词，作 by 的宾语，表示「通过刺激皮肤的方式」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Massage can stimulate the skin and improve blood flow.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 按摩可以刺激皮肤并改善血液流动。
vocab_pack.from_passage: by stimulating the skin

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have to deal with a difficult situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 Faced with 为过去分词短语作状语，逻辑主语为 Walker，表示「面临……」。完整形式可以是 be faced with。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company is faced with serious financial problems.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 公司面临着严重的财务问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Faced with newfound fame and praise online

vocab_pack.grammar_note: newfound 为形容词修饰 fame，在句中作 faced with 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The artist struggled to deal with her newfound fame.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位艺术家难以应对她新获得的名气。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Faced with newfound fame and praise online

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a modest or humble manner
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 humbly 作副词，修饰 said，表示说话方式。
vocab_pack.example_en: The winner humbly thanked everyone for their support.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 获胜者谦虚地感谢了所有人的支持。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Walker humbly said

vocab_pack.definition_en: the accumulated knowledge and insight from ancient people
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为名词短语，作 It's the wisdom of the ancients 的表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Modern medicine often draws on the wisdom of the ancients.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 现代医学常常借鉴古人的智慧。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It's the wisdom of the ancients

vocab_pack.definition_en: to put into practice (knowledge, skills, etc.)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 apply 为一般现在时，主语 I，后接宾语从句 what my teacher taught me。
vocab_pack.example_en: Students should learn to apply theoretical knowledge in real life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生应该学会将理论知识应用到实际生活中。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I just apply what my teacher taught me

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to emphasize the subject of an action (cleft sentence)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 It's patients who are helping the doctors 为强调句型，强调主语 patients；are helping 为现在进行时。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is practice that helps you improve.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 正是练习帮助你提高。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it's patients who are helping the doctors

section_2_word_form.passage:
China's zongzi culture boasts a rich and time-honored history. [56] (it) related stories and legends have been passed down for thousands of years and are known to every Chinese household. During [57] Warring States Period (475 - 221 BC), it's said that a patriotic poet from the State of Chu named Qu Yuan threw himself into a river after the state was conquered. The people of Chu were [58] (deep) saddened, and they went to the river to remember him. In order to protect his body from [59] (eat) by fish and shrimp, people threw rice dumplings into the river every year [60] the anniversary of his death. The dumplings became known as zongzi.
The ingredients [61] (use) to make zongzi vary from region to region, so there are many differences in shape and taste. Most are made with plain white glutinous rice. The northern [62] (variety) are usually sweet, with ingredients such as sugar, a red bean paste and dates. Southern zongzi are savory — especially those from Jiaxing in Zhejiang.
During the Dragon Boat Festival, zongzi are not only enjoyed for their cooking appeal [63] also cherished for their cultural significance. Families gather to make and share the treat, [64] (strength) bonds and fostering a sense of community. Eating zongzi during the festival [65] (believe) to bring good luck and stop evil spirits, making it an essential part of the celebrations.

questions.explanation: 本空后接名词词组 related stories and legends，作定语，需填入形容词性物主代词。指代“粽子文化的”，句首需大写首字母。
questions.supplement: 正确形(Its)：语境句：The company has announced its plan to expand into the global market. 固定搭配：its own, on its own。原词it其它变形：itself(pron.)

questions.explanation: Warring States Period（战国时期）是特指中国历史上的某一个特定时期，由普通名词构成的专有名词前需加定冠词the。
questions.supplement: 正确形(the)：语境句：The Renaissance was a period of great cultural and artistic change. 固定搭配：in the period, the same as

questions.explanation: 修饰后面的形容词（或过去分词作形容词用）saddened，应该使用副词形式 deeply，意为“深深地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(deeply)：语境句：We were deeply moved by the hero's inspiring speech. 固定搭配：deeply care, deeply rooted。原词deep其它变形：deepen(v.), depth(n.)

questions.explanation: 介词 from 后需接动名词(doing)。同时，逻辑主语 his body 与 eat 之间是被动关系（身体被鱼虾吃掉），故应用动名词的被动式 being eaten。
questions.supplement: 正确形(being eaten)：语境句：The leftover food needs to be kept in the fridge to prevent it from being eaten by insects. 固定搭配：prevent from being, avoid being。原词eat其它变形：ate(v.过去式), eaten(v.过去分词), eatable(adj.)

questions.explanation: the anniversary of his death 表示具体的某一天（他的忌辰纪念日），在具体某一天前用介词 on。
questions.supplement: 正确形(on)：语境句：We usually have a grand family dinner on New Year's Eve. 固定搭配：on the anniversary, on Monday

questions.explanation: 句子的谓语动词是 vary，此处 use 作非谓语动词修饰 The ingredients。The ingredients 与 use 是逻辑被动关系（被用来做粽子的原料），故填过去分词 used 作后置定语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(used)：语境句：The methods used in this experiment are highly advanced and reliable. 固定搭配：be used to do, get used to doing。原词use其它变形：useful(adj.), useless(adj.), usage(n.)

questions.explanation: variety意为“品种、种类”，作可数名词。由后面的系动词 are 可知主语应为复数形式，故填 varieties。
questions.supplement: 正确形(varieties)：语境句：The supermarket sells wide varieties of imported fruits and vegetables. 固定搭配：a variety of, different varieties。原词variety其它变形：various(adj.), vary(v.)

questions.explanation: 根据前文的 not only... 可知，此处考查并列连词 not only... but (also)... 句型，表示“不仅……而且……”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(but)：语境句：She is not only intelligent but also extremely hardworking. 固定搭配：not only... but also..., nothing but

questions.explanation: 逗号后作伴随状语，且与后面的 fostering 并列，主动表达“加强联系”，故应填动词的现在分词 strengthening。
questions.supplement: 正确形(strengthening)：语境句：The new policy aims at strengthening cultural communication between the two countries. 固定搭配：strengthen ties, strengthen cooperation。原词strength其它变形：strengthen(v.), strong(adj.), strongly(adv.)

questions.explanation: 主语是 Eating zongzi（动名词作主语），谓语动词用单数。吃粽子和“被认为”之间是被动关系，讲述客观习俗用一般现在时，故填 is believed（被认为能带来好运）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(is believed)：语境句：The ancient temple is believed to have been built over a thousand years ago. 固定搭配：it is believed that, be widely believed。原词believe其它变形：belief(n.), believable(adj.)

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主谓一致（第三人称单数），boast作及物动词，宾语为a rich and time-honored history

vocab_pack.definition_en: respected because of age or long tradition

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时被动语态（have been passed down），主语stories and legends，down为副词

vocab_pack.example_zh: 这些技能由父亲传给儿子。

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时被动语态，主语stories and legends，to引出对象every Chinese household

vocab_pack.from_passage: are known to every Chinese household

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，threw是throw的过去式，himself为反身代词，into引导介词短语

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时被动语态（was conquered），主语the state，conquer的过去分词表示被动

vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座城市被敌人攻克了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: after the state was conquered

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 系表结构，were为系动词，deeply副词修饰saddened（过去分词作形容词），描述主语状态

vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们听到这个消息深感悲痛。
vocab_pack.from_passage: were deeply saddened

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式作目的状语（to remember），及物动词，宾语him

vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们聚集在一起纪念祖先。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to remember him

vocab_pack.grammar_note: protect + 宾语 + from + 动名词被动形式（being eaten），此处protect为原形，与to构成不定式目的状语

vocab_pack.example_zh: 防晒霜保护你的皮肤免受损伤。

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词被动形式（being eaten），作介词from的宾语，表示被吃
vocab_pack.example_en: The food is safe from being eaten by pests.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这些食物没有被虫吃掉的危险。

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，threw为throw的过去式，宾语rice dumplings，into介词短语

vocab_pack.definition_en: annual date of a past event

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，became为系动词，known as固定搭配，主语The dumplings

vocab_pack.definition_en: any of the foods combined to make a dish

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语ingredients，vary为不及物动词，from...to...表示范围

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作介词with的宾语，被plain white修饰

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式作主语，谓语are usually sweet，指北方粽子的种类

vocab_pack.definition_en: sweet paste made from red beans

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数名词，与sugar、red bean paste并列，作such as的宾语
vocab_pack.example_en: Dates are naturally sweet.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 红枣天生很甜。
vocab_pack.from_passage: and dates

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作表语，描述Southern zongzi，与sweet相对

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to give two related facts

vocab_pack.definition_en: attractiveness in terms of taste and preparation

vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时被动语态，主语Eating zongzi，is believed to后接动词原形bring
